summary.text: Ally Seifried is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 2 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Randy Cowling as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Seifried earned a degree in political science from Rogers State University and has worked as a director of client care.
Seifried assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Marty Quinn, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as vice chair of the Education Committee and a member of the Business and Commerce, Senate General Government, and Senate Veterans and Military Affairs committees.
